items.text: OUT-003 demonstrates the later V4-EXM-32 path with identified provider/query contract, admitted sources, research workflow, external host integration, source-backed context and candidate identity, and, for a completed live witness, records an actual content-bound human decision and its scope. Favorable approval is not required and professional reliance is not implied. Its claim is limited to the concrete candidate and observed contributions; negative or partial absence evidence is retained without claiming live-witness completion, and a prepared handoff or simulated case cannot stand in for that witness. Verified by VER-003. [REQ-001, REQ-006; S1, S5]

verification.text: Coordinate the subsequent V4-EXM-32 examination through the human with the external SWB owner after the provider/query, admitted source, workflow and host inputs are actually available. Observe the query-to-context-to-candidate path and an actual content-bound human decision with its scope for the completed live witness; retain candidate/input identities, the evidence observed and limitations. Favorable approval is not required and no professional reliance is inferred. Retain negative or partial evidence of missing inputs or an unobserved act honestly, without claiming live-witness completion. Verifies AC-004.

items.text: OUT-003 includes unavailable or unsuitable research input and relevant stale/limited-source behavior, showing the resulting limits or hold on dependent research without fabricated context, candidate standing or human approval; independently supported work remains possible. Verified by VER-004. [REQ-002, REQ-006; S3 V4-CON-03, S4 V4-HI-62, S5]

verification.text: In the later receiving examination, supply admitted unavailable/unsuitable and relevant stale/limited-input cases under the actual query contract. Inspect reported source limitations, withheld unsupported context or decision claims and continuation of independent sound-basis work. State whether observations came from receiving fixtures or the actual host path; fixture success alone does not qualify the live path. Verifies AC-005.

items.text: OUT-002's act contract and OUT-003's evidence distinguish candidate approval, edit acceptance, execution/application, checking and professional reliance. They support faithful recording of an actual human act with actor distinct from recorder, expose the limits of its content/subject binding, and reject claims derived solely from success, receipt or an unperformed act. They retain unresolved OI-001/OI-002 custody without adding a blanket reserved-act policy or synthetic acceptance dependency. Verified by VER-005. [REQ-005; CLM-006; S1, S2 decision 03, S3, S4, S5]

verification.text: Examine an actual, content-bound human decision and its faithful recording/presentation, keeping the human actor distinct from the host or agent recorder. Compare its exact subject with separately evidenced edit acceptance, application, checking and professional reliance, without requiring one act merely to prove another. Examine claims based only on tool success/receipt, a missing human act and changed candidate content: unsupported attribution is rejected and prior applicability lapses visibly where appropriate. Use the affected adopted operation policy; carry undecided OI-001/OI-002 questions to their owners before fixing dependent criteria or implementation. Verifies AC-006.
